canary-1b-v2.name: Canary 1B v2

cohere-int8.name: Cohere

welcome.title: Your voice, already typing
welcome.body: Ghostly turns speech into finished text wherever your cursor is — email, Slack, your editor, an AI prompt. Two minutes here and you'll know everything it can do.

private.title: Stays on your Mac
private.body: Transcription runs locally. Your voice is never uploaded.

fast.title: About a second
fast.body: Text lands roughly as fast as you can let go of the key.

anywhere.title: Every app
anywhere.body: If you can type into it, you can talk into it.

permissions.title: Two permissions and you're done
permissions.body: macOS asks you, not us — Ghostly can't grant these itself. Both take one click.
permissions.hint: Grant both to continue. Ghostly detects them automatically.
permissions.allSetBody: Ghostly can hear you and type for you.
permissions.footnote: Ghostly only listens while you're holding your shortcut, and only types where your cursor already is.

microphone.title: Microphone
microphone.body: So Ghostly can hear what you say.
microphone.reassurance: Audio is processed on this Mac and never leaves it.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: So your shortcut works everywhere and text can be typed for you.
accessibility.reassurance: Used only for your shortcut and pasting — nothing is monitored.

shortcut.body: That's the entire product. Your words appear wherever the cursor is — no window to open, no button to click.
shortcut.sample: Shipping the new onboarding flow today.

beats.release: Let go — text lands at your cursor
beats.releaseToggle: Press again — text lands at your cursor

mode.title: How recording starts
mode.holdBody: Recording lasts as long as you hold the key. Best for short bursts.
mode.toggleBody: One press starts, another stops. Best for long dictation.

shortcut.rebindHint: Prefer a different key? Change it in Settings → Shortcuts.

practice.title: Say something
practice.body: This is a real text field and a real transcription. Whatever you say lands right here.
practice.hint: Nothing to type — just hold your shortcut and talk.
practice.doneHint: That's it. That's the whole thing.
practice.beforeBody: Everything you're about to say is transcribed on this Mac. No audio is uploaded, and nothing is stored unless you keep it.
practice.afterBody: That transcription ran entirely on your Mac — and it works exactly the same in every other app you use.

prompts.0: Hey, can you send me that report before Friday? Thanks.
prompts.1: Let's move the sync to Thursday afternoon and loop in the design team.
prompts.2: Quick note — the client approved the new pricing, so we can ship next week.

refinement.title: Want it cleaned up?
refinement.body: Speech comes with filler words, false starts, and no punctuation. Refinement fixes all of that before the text lands — and it's optional.
refinement.changeLater: Change this anytime in Settings → AI Refinement.
refinement.saveFailed: Couldn't save that choice. Try again.

sample.before: um so can you like send me the report by friday i think
sample.after: Can you send me the report by Friday?

apple_intelligence.title: Apple Intelligence
apple_intelligence.body: Runs on-device. No API key, no setup, nothing leaves your Mac.

byok.title: Bring your own API key
byok.body: OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, Cerebras, OpenRouter, Z.AI, or a custom endpoint. Add your key in Settings.

none.title: No refinement
none.body: Raw transcription only. Fastest, fully offline, every word exactly as spoken.

refinement.maxNote: No API key? Ghostly Max runs it hosted, from $12/month. Everything above stays free.

highlights.title: Three things Ghostly also does
highlights.body: Not dictation, and not obvious from the main window. These are why people keep Ghostly open.
highlights.hint: Nothing to set up now — this is just so you know it's there.

notes.title: Notes
notes.body: Every transcription is saved as a searchable note — what you said, when you said it, and which app you were in. Tag them, star them, come back to them.

meetings.title: Meeting Mode
meetings.body: Live transcription of your calls in a floating panel, both sides, on this Mac. Ghostly never joins — no bot in your participant list. Ask “Where were we?” to catch up.
meetings.where: Meetings, in the sidebar — off until you switch it on.

openMic.title: Open Mic
openMic.body: Leave the mic open and stop touching keys. Every pause becomes a transcription — finish with your submit phrase to send it.
openMic.where: Dictation, in the sidebar — off until you switch it on.

features.title: Five things people miss
features.body: Shortcut-level power, already installed. Every binding below can be changed later.
features.hint: Use ← → to browse. Everything here lives in Settings too.

verbatim.title: Verbatim dictation
verbatim.body: Transcribes exactly what you say with no rewriting at all. The escape hatch for quotes, code, names, and anything an AI shouldn't touch.
verbatim.example: “Write a function that takes a user ID and returns…” — every word, untouched.

editLast.title: Edit what you just said
editLast.body: Revise the last thing you dictated by talking to it, or use the quick chips: shorten, lengthen, fix grammar, rephrase.

screenshot.title: Screenshot + dictate
screenshot.body: Captures your screen alongside your question and stages both, ready to drop into any AI chat that accepts images.
screenshot.example: “Why is this build failing?” — with the error already attached.

styles.title: Per-app writing styles
styles.body: Ghostly knows the difference between Slack and a client email, and adjusts tone and cleanup to match the app you're in.
styles.example: Casual in Slack. Formal in Mail. Verbatim in your editor.

dictionary.title: Your dictionary
dictionary.body: Teach Ghostly the names, products, and jargon it keeps getting wrong — including how they sound versus how they're spelled.

finish.title: You're set up
finish.body: Ghostly lives in your menu bar from here. It stays out of the way until you hold your shortcut.

where.tray: Ghostly runs from the menu bar — click the ghost to open settings anytime.
where.notes: Everything you dictate is saved under Notes, searchable and easy to reuse.
where.replay: Want this tour again? Settings → App → Guided tour.

upgrade.title: Installing a better model
upgrade.body: Dictation already works. This downloads in the background and switches itself on when it's ready.

finish.errorReports: Send anonymous crash reports to help fix bugs. No audio, no transcriptions, ever.

modelSettings.title: {{model}} Settings
modelSettings.noSettingsNeeded: This model works automatically with no configuration needed.

shortcut.title: Shortcuts
shortcut.description: Keyboard shortcuts that trigger recording and transcription

transcribe.name: Record & Transcribe
transcribe.description: Hold to record. Release to transcribe and paste into the active app.

cancel.name: Cancel Recording
cancel.description: Cancel the current recording without transcribing.

transcribe_with_screenshot.name: Screenshot + Dictate
transcribe_with_screenshot.description: Captures the screen on press, records your question, and pastes the vision LLM's answer. Requires a vision-capable provider (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Z.AI, or Groq).

transcribe_verbatim.name: Dictate Verbatim
transcribe_verbatim.description: Transcribes exactly what you say with no AI refinement of any kind. Use when dictating prompts, quotes, or anything that must not be rewritten.

errors.reset: Failed to reset shortcut to original value

language.title: Language
language.description: The spoken language Ghostly should expect. Auto detects automatically; picking a specific language can improve accuracy.
language.descriptionUnsupported: This model detects language automatically — no manual selection needed.

pushToTalk.label: Push to Talk
pushToTalk.description: Hold the shortcut to record; release to stop and transcribe.

models.title: Transcription Models
models.description: Select a transcription model or download additional models. Different models offer varying levels of accuracy and speed.
models.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete {{modelName}}? You will need to download it again to use it.
models.deleteActiveConfirm: {{modelName}} is your active model. Deleting it will stop transcriptions until you select a new model. Are you sure?
models.subtitle: Pick how Ghostly balances speed against accuracy. You can change this at any time — switching takes a moment, nothing is lost.
models.bundledNote: Built into Ghostly, so it works the moment you install. Pick a tier above for better accuracy.
models.otherNote: Chosen from All models. Pick a tier above to go back to a standard option.
models.allModelsHint: Every engine Ghostly supports, including specialised and language-specific models. Most people never need this.

Fast.name: Fast
Fast.promise: Text appears almost the instant you stop talking. Best for chat, prompts, and short notes.

Balanced.name: Balanced
Balanced.promise: Quick enough to feel immediate, accurate enough to trust with real writing. The right choice for most people.

Accurate.name: Most accurate
Accurate.promise: The best transcription Ghostly can produce, in the most languages. Noticeably slower.

microphone.title: Microphone
microphone.description: Choose which microphone Ghostly listens to. System Default follows the input macOS is currently using and auto-switches when devices are plugged or unplugged.

audioFeedback.label: Sound Feedback
audioFeedback.description: Play a chime when recording starts and stops.

soundTheme.label: Sound Theme
soundTheme.description: The sound played when recording starts and stops.

outputDevice.title: Feedback Speaker
outputDevice.description: Which speaker plays the start/stop chimes.

volume.title: Feedback Volume
volume.description: Volume level for the start/stop chimes.

experimentalToggle.label: Developer Mode
experimentalToggle.description: Unlock additional debug options for developers and power users.

lazyStreamClose.label: Warm Mic Mode
lazyStreamClose.description: Keeps the microphone open for 30 seconds after stopping, cutting startup delay for back-to-back dictation. May temporarily affect Bluetooth audio quality.

continuousDictation.label: Open Mic
continuousDictation.description: Hands-free dictation: leave the mic open and Ghostly transcribes each utterance on silence. No key press per sentence.
continuousDictation.warning: While the mic is open it stays open the entire time. This can degrade Bluetooth audio quality in all other apps. Only what's spoken gets transcribed — but any nearby voice or loud playback can trigger a segment. Close the mic with the shortcut or button when you step away.
continuousDictation.silenceDescription: How long a pause must last (ms) before the current utterance is closed and transcribed. Shorter = snappier; longer = fewer fragmentations.
continuousDictation.minDescription: Segments shorter than this (ms) are dropped as noise (coughs, clicks, short sounds).
continuousDictation.maxDescription: Hard cap (ms) on a single segment. If you speak longer than this without pausing, Ghostly force-transcribes mid-stream.
continuousDictation.submitPhraseDescription: When a segment ends with this phrase, Ghostly strips it and presses the submit key — say "…send it" to fire off a chat message hands-free.
continuousDictation.submitKeyDescription: Which keystroke to send when the submit phrase is detected.

whisper.title: Whisper GPU Acceleration
whisper.description: Hardware acceleration for Whisper models. Auto uses GPU when available (Metal on macOS, Vulkan on Windows/Linux). Switch to CPU if you encounter stability issues.

ort.title: ONNX GPU Acceleration
ort.description: Hardware acceleration for ONNX-based models (Parakeet, Canary, Moonshine). DirectML on Windows is experimental and may cause transcription failures.

gpuDevice.title: GPU Device
gpuDevice.description: Which GPU to use for Whisper inference. Auto selects the best available device.

startHidden.label: Start in Background
startHidden.description: Launch Ghostly silently to the tray without opening the settings window.

autostart.label: Launch on Startup
autostart.description: Automatically start Ghostly when you log in to your computer.

showTrayIcon.label: Show Tray Icon
showTrayIcon.description: Display the Ghostly icon in the menu bar.

showDockIcon.label: Show Dock Icon
showDockIcon.description: Display the Ghostly icon in the Dock. At least one of the Dock or menu bar icons must remain enabled.

overlay.title: Overlay Position
overlay.description: Where the recording pill sits on screen during normal dictation. Pick a corner to keep it clear of the area you're typing in.

stagedOverlay.title: Screenshot & Dictation Overlay Position
stagedOverlay.description: Where the screenshot + dictation preview sits while you focus a target field to paste into.

pasteMethod.title: How to Insert Text
pasteMethod.description: Clipboard (recommended): copies text then pastes with a keyboard shortcut. Direct: types characters one by one — use if clipboard paste is unreliable. None: captures to history only without pasting.

typingTool.title: Linux Typing Tool
typingTool.description: Which tool Ghostly uses for Direct text input on Linux. Auto detects the best available option for your setup.

clipboardHandling.title: After Pasting
clipboardHandling.description: Controls what happens to your clipboard after text is inserted.

autoSubmit.title: Send Automatically
autoSubmit.description: Press a key automatically after inserting text — useful for chat apps or search bars.

translateToEnglish.label: Translate to English
translateToEnglish.description: Automatically translate speech from other languages to English during transcription.
translateToEnglish.descriptionUnsupported: Translation is not supported by the {{model}} model.

modelUnload.title: Release Model Memory
modelUnload.description: Automatically unload the AI model from GPU/RAM after a period of inactivity. Lower values free memory sooner; higher values keep the model ready for faster recordings.

customWords.title: Correction Words
customWords.description: Words Ghostly should always prefer over similar-sounding alternatives. Great for proper nouns, brand names, or technical terms.
customWords.presetAlreadyAdded: All words from this preset are already added

presets.title: Vocabulary presets
presets.description: One-click add curated technical terms. Great for coding and AI-assistant workflows.

fillerWords.title: Filler Word Removal
fillerWords.description: Strip fillers (um, uh, like) from transcripts automatically. Uses smart language defaults out of the box.
fillerWords.addDescription: Words to strip from every transcription. One word per entry.

enable.label: Enable AI Refinement
enable.description: Use AI to clean up, format, or rephrase your transcriptions after they're captured. Requires an AI provider API key or Apple Intelligence.

aiAppBypass.label: Skip AI refinement in AI apps
aiAppBypass.description: In Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Claude Code and similar apps, clean transcriptions locally instead of sending them to a refinement model. Prevents the model from acting on a dictated prompt instead of typing it, and pastes noticeably faster. Recommended.

connection.needsKey: Add your API key below to enable refinement
connection.needsModel: Select a model below to enable refinement

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Choose which AI service refines your transcriptions.

appleIntelligence.title: Apple Intelligence
appleIntelligence.description: Runs fully on-device. No API key or network access is required.
appleIntelligence.requirements: Requires an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS Tahoe (26.0) or later. Apple Intelligence must be enabled in System Settings.
appleIntelligence.unavailable: Apple Intelligence is not available on this device. Requires an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS Tahoe (26.0) or later with Apple Intelligence enabled in System Settings.

baseUrl.title: Base URL
baseUrl.description: API base URL for the selected provider. Only the custom provider can be edited.

apiKey.title: API Key
apiKey.description: API key for the selected provider.

model.title: Model
model.descriptionApple: Provide an optional numeric token limit or keep the default on-device preset.
model.descriptionCustom: Provide the model identifier expected by your custom endpoint.
model.descriptionDefault: Choose a model exposed by the selected provider.

testConnection.title: Test connection
testConnection.description: Sends a tiny request to verify your provider, model, and API key work together.
testConnection.success: Connection works — AI refinement is ready.

prompts.title: Refinement Prompt

selectedPrompt.title: Active Prompt
selectedPrompt.description: The instructions the AI uses to clean up every transcription. Per-app profiles can override tone and formatting automatically.

prompts.promptLabelPlaceholder: e.g. Clean up, Email, Code review
prompts.promptInstructionsPlaceholder: Describe how to transform the transcription. Example: Fix grammar and punctuation for the following text: ${output}
prompts.promptTip: Tip: Use ${output} to insert the transcribed text in your prompt.
prompts.selectToEdit: Select a prompt above to edit it.
prompts.createFirst: Create a prompt to define how the AI should transform your transcriptions.

history.title: Notes
history.description: Every transcription is saved here as a note — a searchable history of what you've dictated. Add tags, star favorites, and regenerate titles with AI.
history.empty: No transcriptions yet — hold your shortcut and start speaking.
history.deleteError: Failed to delete entry. Please try again.
history.retranscribeError: Failed to retranscribe. Please try again.
history.transcriptionFailed: Transcription failed. You can retry using the retranscribe button.

tags.filterOrConfigure: Click to filter · right-click for options
tags.deleteConfirm: Remove the "{{name}}" tag from every note? This cannot be undone.

history.subtitle: Everything you have dictated, when you said it, and where.

logDirectory.title: Log Directory
logDirectory.description: Location where log files are stored

logLevel.title: Log Level
logLevel.description: Verbosity of log output. Info is recommended for normal use; Trace captures everything.

soundTheme.label: Sound Theme
soundTheme.description: The sound played when recording starts and stops.

wordCorrectionThreshold.title: Word Correction Sensitivity
wordCorrectionThreshold.description: How closely a word must match your correction list to be replaced. Lower = stricter; higher = more aggressive matching.

historyLimit.title: Keep Last N Audio Recordings
historyLimit.description: Older audio recordings are removed automatically once this limit is reached. Text transcriptions are always kept.

recordingRetention.title: Keep Recordings For
recordingRetention.description: Audio recordings can take up disk space. Delete them automatically after this period.

alwaysOnMicrophone.label: Warm Mic Mode
alwaysOnMicrophone.description: Keep the microphone active between recordings to reduce startup delay. Uses slightly more power.

clamshellMicrophone.title: Closed-Lid Microphone
clamshellMicrophone.description: Which microphone to use when your laptop lid is closed.

muteWhileRecording.label: Mute System Audio While Recording
muteWhileRecording.description: Silence other audio output while recording to prevent feedback.

appendTrailingSpace.label: Add Space After Pasting
appendTrailingSpace.description: Automatically append a space after the transcription is pasted, so the cursor is ready for the next word.

keyboardImplementation.title: Shortcut Engine
keyboardImplementation.description: How Ghostly listens for your keyboard shortcut. Ghostly Input Engine is lower-latency and recommended. System Shortcut is more compatible but may add a small delay.
keyboardImplementation.bindingsReset: Keyboard shortcuts were incompatible and have been reset to defaults

pasteDelay.title: Paste Delay (ms)
pasteDelay.description: Milliseconds to wait before sending the paste keystroke. Increase this if the wrong text is being pasted.

recordingBuffer.title: Release Buffer (ms)
recordingBuffer.description: Extra milliseconds to keep recording after you release the key, to capture the end of your sentence. 0 = no buffer.

appDataDirectory.title: App Data Directory
appDataDirectory.description: Location where Ghostly stores its data

eula.title: End User License Agreement
eula.description: The terms you accepted when installing Ghostly.

profiles.title: Per-App Profiles
profiles.intro: Your active refinement prompt runs on every transcription by default. Profiles let you override the prompt, vocabulary, or provider when a specific app is in focus — so you don't have to switch prompts manually as you move between apps.

enable.title: Enable Per-App Profiles
enable.description: Automatically switch your AI prompt, vocabulary, and other settings based on which app is in focus when you transcribe.

builtin.title: Use built-in profiles
builtin.description: Recognize IDEs (Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf, VS Code, Replit) and enable their voice commands, auto-submit, and image-paste behavior.

custom.emptyHint: Create a profile to override the prompt, vocabulary, or provider for a specific app. Custom profiles take priority over built-ins.

profiles.detectCurrentHint: Switch focus to the target app, then click to prefill a matching rule.

fields.name: Name
fields.rulesHint: Any rule matching will activate this profile. Most specific rule first.
fields.rulesEmpty: No rules yet. Add one or detect the current app.
fields.promptDescription: Pick a refinement prompt to use while this app is in focus. Inherit keeps your global active prompt, which is the default behavior.
fields.customVocabHint: Merged with the global custom words list for this profile.
fields.imagePasteShiftHint: Needed for apps like VS Code Copilot Chat that expect Shift+Cmd+V for attachments.

style.title: Style

enable.title: Style Matching
enable.description: Ghostly tunes how your dictation gets written based on which app you're in — casual for messages, polished for email, clean for work chat.

appliesIn.personal_messages: This style applies in personal messengers
appliesIn.work_messages: This style applies in workplace messengers
appliesIn.email: This style applies in all major email apps
appliesIn.coding: This style applies in IDEs and coding agents
appliesIn.otherHint: Default for any app not in another category

style.appliesInHint: Auto-applies when the matching app is focused.

custom.title: Custom
custom.subtitle: Your own instructions
custom.empty: Click to write custom instructions for this category.

custom.promptPlaceholder: Describe how Ghostly should rewrite the transcript. e.g. “Keep it short, lowercase, and drop punctuation.”
custom.promptHint: This overrides the preset. Auto Cleanup still runs first.

vocab.title: Vocabulary for this category
vocab.hint: Words Ghostly should recognize when dictating into these apps. Merged with your Dictionary.
vocab.duplicate: That word is already in this category's vocabulary.

cleanup.headerTitle: Auto Cleanup applies to all your dictations
cleanup.headerSubtitle: Choose how much Ghostly automatically edits your dictation each time.

none.title: None
none.subtitle: Transcribes exactly what you said, including mistakes
none.sample: hey joey, we still on for coffee or i think we maybe should leave earlier to make it there in time there might um be traffic. what are you thinking?

light.title: Light
light.subtitle: Removes filler words and corrects grammar
light.sample: Hey joey, are we still on for coffee? I think we should leave earlier to make it there in time. There might be traffic. What are you thinking?

medium.title: Medium
medium.subtitle: Improves clarity, removes “ums,” and makes more concise
medium.sample: Hey joey, are we still on for coffee? We should leave earlier; there might be traffic. What do you think?

high.title: High
high.subtitle: Rewrites for brevity and polish while keeping your meaning
high.sample: Hey joey, are we still on for coffee? Let's leave early to beat traffic. What do you think?

advanced.title: Advanced rules
advanced.description: Override the category style for a specific app using bundle IDs, process names, or window titles. Custom rules take priority over categories.

developer.intro: Two features that turn dictation into a full hands-free workflow for AI IDEs, chat apps, and anywhere else you type to submit.

autoSubmit.sectionDescription: After you stop speaking, Ghostly can press Enter or ⌘-Enter for you.
autoSubmit.worksEverywhere: Works in any app that sends on Enter or ⌘-Enter — Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT, Slack, iMessage, Discord, Linear, and more.

smartVocab.sectionDescription: Ghostly swaps vocabulary based on the app you're dictating into.
smartVocab.body: Your Dictionary lets you teach Ghostly words for each context — coding terms in an IDE, work jargon in Slack, email phrasing in Mail — so transcription picks the right word automatically.
smartVocab.exampleCoding: Coding in Cursor → React, TypeScript, shadcn, pnpm, Supabase
smartVocab.exampleWork: Messaging in Slack → teammate names, project codewords, internal acronyms
smartVocab.exampleEmail: Writing in Mail → formal phrasing, client names

voiceEditing.title: Voice Editing

enable.title: Enable voice editing
enable.description: Keep a short buffer of recent transcriptions so you can revise your last paste by speaking an edit instruction.

voiceEditing.experimental: Experimental — may misfire in rich-text editors and fields where the cursor moved.

prefixDetection.title: Prefix detection
prefixDetection.description: Treat short utterances starting with phrases like 'fix that' or 'make it shorter' as edit commands. Risk of false positives — leave off unless you want it.

replaceStrategy.title: Replace strategy
replaceStrategy.description: How voice edits replace the previously pasted text.

bufferSize.title: Session buffer size
bufferSize.description: Number of recent transcriptions kept for voice-edit context.

idleTimeout.title: Session idle timeout
idleTimeout.description: Seconds before the session buffer expires and voice edits no longer chain off the last paste.

vocabulary.title: Vocabulary
vocabulary.addDescription: Unique words Ghostly should learn — proper nouns, brand names, acronyms, jargon. No spaces; one word per entry.

csv.empty: No valid words found in that file.
csv.nothingNew: All words in that file are already in your vocabulary.

tags.legendHint: Click a tag to limit a word to that context. Unset = applies everywhere.

correctionPhrases.title: Correction Phrases

enable.title: Enable correction phrases
enable.description: Say a phrase mid-speech (e.g. 'scratch that') to discard everything before it in the same recording. Only what you say after the phrase gets pasted.

correctionPhrases.phrasesDescription: Say any of these mid-recording to cut everything before it. Matched case-insensitively with word boundaries.

health.title: Health
health.subtitle: Everything Ghostly needs in order to work, checked in one place. If dictation has stopped behaving, start here.
health.runFailed: Could not run the health check.

summary.Warn: Working, with something to look at

summaryDetail.Pass: All checks passed. Ghostly is ready to use.
summaryDetail.Warn: Core dictation works, but an optional feature needs attention.
summaryDetail.Fail: One or more required permissions or files are missing.

microphone.label: Microphone access
microphone.Fail: macOS is blocking microphone access, so recordings will be silent.

accessibility.label: Accessibility access
accessibility.Fail: Without this, the global shortcut and pasting into other apps will not work. macOS often revokes it after an update.

model.label: Transcription model
model.Fail: The selected model is missing or incomplete. Download it again.

inputDevice.label: Input device
inputDevice.Fail: No microphone was found on this Mac.

inputDeviceMissing.label: Input device
inputDeviceMissing.Warn: "{{detail}}" is selected but not connected. Ghostly will fall back to the system default.

refinementOff.label: AI refinement
refinementOff.Pass: Turned off. Transcripts are pasted exactly as spoken.

refinementNoProvider.label: AI refinement
refinementNoProvider.Warn: Refinement is on but no provider is configured.

refinementUnreachable.label: AI refinement
refinementUnreachable.Warn: {{detail}}. Dictation still works — transcripts paste unrefined.

shortcut.label: Dictation shortcut
shortcut.Fail: No shortcut is bound, so there is no way to start dictating.

meetingCapture.label: Meeting capture
meetingCapture.Pass: Ghostly can capture the other participants in a call.
meetingCapture.Warn: Transcripts will contain your side of the call only.

health.supportDescription: Tools that make a bug report actionable.
health.bundleDescription: Saves your logs, settings, and system details to the Desktop as a folder you can attach to an email. Contains no transcripts, audio, or keys.
health.exportDone: Diagnostics bundle saved to your Desktop.
health.errorReportingDescription: Report when something fails, so recurring problems get fixed. Off by default.
health.privacyNote: An error report contains only the kind of failure, your Ghostly version, your macOS version, and which model and provider were in use. It never contains what you said, what you typed, your audio, your API keys, or anything that identifies you.

appearance.title: Theme
appearance.description: Ghostly is designed for dark. Light is fully supported if you prefer it.

milestoneNotifications.label: Milestone notifications
milestoneNotifications.description: Get a notification when your lifetime dictation passes the length of a well-known book — The Great Gatsby, Moby-Dick, all seven Harry Potters. Only landmark titles notify; the sidebar tracks every one.

tour.title: Guided tour
tour.description: Replay the walkthrough of shortcuts, refinement, and the features that aren't on the surface.

general.title: General
general.subtitle: Appearance, startup, and where Ghostly lives on your Mac.

app.title: App
app.subtitle: How Ghostly behaves as an application.

transcription.title: Transcription
transcription.subtitle: The speech model, language, and vocabulary Ghostly uses.

refinement.title: Refinement
refinement.subtitle: How dictated text is cleaned up before it lands.

advanced.title: Dictation
advanced.subtitle: Shortcuts, open mic, and how text is inserted.

restApi.title: Local API
restApi.sectionDescription: An HTTP server on your machine that lets scripts and other apps drive Ghostly. Nothing is exposed to the network.
restApi.securityNote: Localhost only. Every request needs the token, and browser requests are refused.

enabled.title: Enable local API
enabled.description: Starts an HTTP server on 127.0.0.1 so scripts, Raycast, Shortcuts, Stream Deck and AI agents can control Ghostly. Turning this off stops the server immediately.

port.title: Port
port.description: The port the API listens on. Default: 7543. Changes take effect immediately.

token.title: API token
token.description: Every request must send this token. Treat it like a password: it can read your transcription history and type into the app you have focused.
token.regenerateConfirm: Generate a new token? Any script using the current one will stop working.

docs.title: Endpoints
docs.description: Hover a row and click the copy icon for a ready-to-run curl command.

test.notListening: The API is not listening. Try toggling it off and on.
test.portMismatch: The API is listening on {{actual}}, not the port shown. Try toggling it off and on.

cli.sectionDescription: Drive Ghostly from a terminal, a script, a foot pedal, or anything else that can run a command.

install.title: Install the ghostly command
install.description: Adds a ghostly command to your PATH so you can run it from any terminal. You may be asked for your password.

cli.installedNeedsPath: Installed, but the folder needs adding to your PATH

panel.title: Meeting
panel.micOnly: Your side only — the other participants aren't being captured.

settings.enableDescription: Transcribe calls live, with a floating panel you can read during the meeting. Ghostly never joins the call.
settings.consentNotice: Recording a conversation may require everyone's consent where you live. Ghostly always shows a visible indicator while capturing, and transcripts stay on this Mac.
settings.systemAudioDescription: Records the call's audio so the transcript includes everyone, not just you. Uses a CoreAudio process tap — no screen recording permission needed.
settings.livePanelDescription: A floating window that stays above your call and shows the transcript as it happens.
settings.autoConnectDescription: Ghostly notices a call by checking whether a conferencing app is actually using your microphone — not merely running.
settings.countdownDescription: How long you get to cancel before capture begins.
settings.autoStopDescription: How long to wait once no call is detected. Generous by default, because apps briefly release audio when you mute.
settings.exclusionsDescription: Comma-separated words. If a meeting's name contains one, Ghostly won't offer to capture it.
settings.summaryBackendDescription: Where meeting summaries are generated. On-device keeps everything on this Mac.
settings.cloudWarning: Meeting transcripts will be sent to your configured AI provider. This is separate from dictation refinement.
settings.yourNameDescription: Used to notice when someone addresses you directly during a call.
settings.mentionAlertsDescription: Notifies you when a participant says your name in a question or asks something of you.
settings.retentionDescription: Meetings older than this are deleted automatically at launch.
settings.startNowHint: Begins capturing immediately without waiting for detection.
settings.liveRefinementDescription: Fixes punctuation, casing and misheard names as each line arrives. Corrected lines replace themselves in the panel a moment after they appear.
settings.liveRefinementCloudWarning: Every transcript line will be sent to your configured AI provider as the meeting runs.

library.title: Meetings
library.subtitle: Transcripts and summaries from your calls. Everything here stays on this Mac.
library.empty: No meetings yet. Start one from the Settings tab or let Ghostly detect your next call.
library.noTranscript: Nothing was transcribed in this meeting.
library.retentionHint: Meeting transcripts are kept on this Mac only. Change how long they're kept in the Settings tab.

provider.title: AI runs on Ghostly Max
provider.description: No provider to pick, no API key to paste, no model to choose. Your dictation is still transcribed entirely on this Mac — only the text is sent for refinement.
provider.privacyNote: Ghostly never sends your audio anywhere. Transcription is always on-device, on every plan.
provider.notActive: AI refinement is currently routed to {{provider}}, not Ghostly Max.

overflow.title: Personal API key (optional)
overflow.description: If you ever reach the monthly fair-use limit, Ghostly can keep going on your own API key instead of stopping. It is only used after Max runs out — nothing is sent to it otherwise.
overflow.providerDescription: Which provider Ghostly falls back to when the Max allowance runs out.
overflow.apiKeyDescription: Stored on this Mac only. Ghostly uses it exclusively as an overflow, never before then.
overflow.modelDescription: The model to use on that provider. Pick one from the list or type an id.
overflow.baseUrlDescription: The OpenAI-compatible endpoint to send overflow requests to.

account.title: Ghostly Max
account.requestsHelp: The limit is set far above normal use — it exists to stop runaway scripts, not to meter you. Email support if you need it raised.
account.offline: Couldn't reach Ghostly Max to check your usage. Your subscription is unaffected.
account.manageHelp: Update your card, download invoices, or cancel.
account.noSubscription: This licence has no subscription attached, so there is nothing to manage.
account.portalFailed: Couldn't open the billing portal. Try again in a moment.

errors.notMax: This licence doesn't include hosted AI. Subscribe to Ghostly Max, or add your own API key.
errors.expired: Your Ghostly Max subscription has lapsed. Renew it to turn hosted AI back on.
errors.unpaid: Your last Ghostly Max payment didn't go through. Update your billing details to restore hosted AI.
errors.revoked: This licence has been revoked. Contact support if this is unexpected.
errors.fairUseExceeded: You've used this month's Ghostly Max allowance. It resets next month — add a personal API key to keep going now.
errors.upstreamError: The AI service is temporarily unavailable. Your transcription was pasted unrefined.
errors.invalidKey: Ghostly Max didn't recognise this licence. Try reactivating it below.
errors.generic: Hosted AI is currently unavailable for this licence.

upsell.noKeyHint: Don't have an API key? Ghostly Max runs AI for you — nothing to set up.
